interpretation: All processing-ready lifetime counters are retained, including setup, steady loop, saving and closure. The 610-second observation window is not a separate audio pass.
The effect lost 276353 frames in 67 gaps; the instrument lost 279862 frames in 77 gaps. Both positively retired with no remaining leases.

The selected PulseAudio playback backend is a fixture limitation: Ardour processes whenever its stream has writable space, which can yield back-to-back callbacks. The installed state and retained first gaps corroborate shortened demand intervals. No unique cause is assigned to all gaps.
Native publication always followed the retained consumer gaps; no retained record here demonstrates available output being wrongly discarded.

Guest user-slice CPU throttling and memory/task limit counters did not increase during the 610-second monitor. Outer-VM throttling existed, but was not sampled at this run boundary or correlated to individual losses.
SDK successes do not qualify this DAW result. Diagnostics can alter timing. Internal54 remains failed and this run does not repair it.
The original project is unchanged. The new snapshot contains exact verified class/module identities and actual first-party component/controller settings; persistence across reopen remains untested.
